description: This Java source file implements the '<trace>' element as part of the Mini-language framework within the OFBiz project. It defines the Trace class which manages tracing levels during method execution, including enabling/disabling trace output and executing nested operations.

classes.name: Trace
classes.description: Represents the '<trace>' element, handling trace level configuration and execution of nested operations during method execution.

classes.name: Trace.TraceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of Trace from XML elements.

methods.name: Trace
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Trace object based on XML attributes and nested operations.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the trace operation, toggling trace on, executing nested operations, then toggling trace off.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the trace element with level information.
